permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: lo reaches its own server to sign you in and to load and publish posts, a transcription service to turn a spoken post into text, open map services for the walking route and streets drawn on the map beside a place, and a public CDN for the font the phone screen is set in.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: lo uses your phone location to load nearby information and publish your saved places and spoken posts.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Press and hold on the glasses to record a spoken post.
